entries.zh: 向尊长行礼并禀告请示；拜见禀报
entries.en: to bow before a superior and report or petition; to pay one's respects while asking leave
entries.notes: 页首承接上页残文，L 栏经行间补字可读作 reuer[enciar] a el … licencia；释义主要依 H「拜稟」与 M「pai pin」推定。

entries.zh: 孝敬赡养父母；尽孝供养
entries.en: filial reverence and care for one's parents
to support and provide for one's parents or elders with respect

entries.zh: 祭祀家中神灵与祖先（祭奠亡故父母）
entries.en: to make offerings to the household spirits and ancestors; reverence to deceased parents
entries.notes: H 作「祭家神」而 L 言亡故父母，所指相关而不全同；M 栏 que/gue 之读存疑。

entries.zh: 以客套、敬语称呼致意；礼貌的称呼
entries.en: to address someone with courteous words and acknowledgements; polite address

entries.notes: H 栏仅存「到」字、L 栏 voluer/volver 存疑、M 仅一音节 ho，材料不足，不能定其义。
H 栏首字缺失，R 栏「maṅdach」难解；仅据「皇」与 L「Rey」定其大意。
M 栏作 rey，与「帝」的闽南音不合，疑混入西语词；据 H「帝」与 L「rey」定。

entries.zh: 圣上（对当朝皇帝的敬称）
万岁爷（对皇帝的尊称，犹呼「万岁」）
entries.en: 'Lord of Ten Thousand Years' — honorific address and acclamation for the emperor
entries.notes: M 栏「ban ban」疑为「萬萬歲」式重呼，R 栏为残损西语注文，故只定其尊称义。

entries.en: Son of Heaven; the emperor of China

entries.zh: 人主（万民之主，指中国皇帝）
entries.en: lord of men; the sovereign (the emperor of China)

entries.zh: 诸侯（一方之君、附庸君主）
entries.notes: L 栏疑读 reyeçuelo（小王、诸侯），与 H「諸侯」相合；R 栏疑为西语校记「verifíquelo」，非对音。

entries.en: king of the devils; king of ghosts
